reason_for_v2: Code audit before inspecting v1 output found that a q with fewer than K eligible centers in some inner folds could be averaged over only its surviving folds, creating unequal comparison support across q values.
objective: select ecological support breadth from outer-training data using the same downstream set-level survey-recovery objective, with strictly paired and complete inner-fold comparisons

method.selector: greedy maximum newly covered public land-grid cells within the support mask
method.selection_rule: for each outer-training fold and budget, every q must produce K sites in every inner fold; compute paired per-inner-fold recall differences q minus q=1; if no feasible q<1 has positive mean paired lift, choose q=1; otherwise choose the q with the largest mean paired lift, exact ties toward broader q

hard_boundaries: No v1 output was inspected before this correction was defined.
Outer-held-out coordinates are invisible to q selection.
All q comparisons use identical inner folds for a given budget.
Infeasible q values are rejected, not averaged over a subset of folds.
No Campanula field coordinates are used.
Frozen 192 Practical Core taxa remain untouched.
No new q, K, radius, or environmental variable is introduced.
